description: Produce a deterministic, reproducible graph of files, packages, symbols, and import edges per target scenario by delegating to go-code-graph and typescript-code-graph; cartographer never parses source code itself.

requirements.description: Cartographer must produce a deterministic, reproducible graph of files, packages, symbols, and import edges for any target scenario by delegating all source-code parsing to go-code-graph and typescript-code-graph via Connect-RPC. Cartographer must never parse source code itself. The graph is normalized into an immutable snapshot model upon receipt. Adapters for both go-code-graph (AC-GRAPH-GO-EXTRACT) and typescript-code-graph (AC-GRAPH-TS-EXTRACT) must be implemented. The normalized graph model (AC-GRAPH-MODEL) must be immutable after construction. Golden determinism tests (AC-GRAPH-DETERMINISM) must compare cartographer output to hand-curated expected-graph JSON fixtures under bas/fixtures/ for known cycle, mislocated-file, and orphan-file scenarios.
requirements.title: Ground-Truth Code Graph Extraction via Delegated Adapters

validation.notes: AC-GRAPH-MODEL: Graph snapshot struct is immutable after construction — any mutation attempt returns an error or is rejected at compile time
AC-GRAPH-MODEL: Normalization correctly deduplicates nodes and edges from raw adapter output
AC-GRAPH-GO-EXTRACT: Adapter correctly maps go-code-graph proto response fields to internal graph model nodes and edges
AC-GRAPH-TS-EXTRACT: Adapter correctly maps typescript-code-graph proto response fields to internal graph model nodes and edges
AC-GRAPH-DETERMINISM: Two successive calls with the same inputs produce byte-identical serialized graph snapshots
AC-GRAPH-GO-EXTRACT: End-to-end extraction against a fixture Go module (bas/fixtures/go-cycles/) produces a graph matching hand-curated expected-graph.json
AC-GRAPH-TS-EXTRACT: End-to-end extraction against a fixture TS package (bas/fixtures/ts-junk-drawer/) produces a graph matching hand-curated expected-graph.json
AC-GRAPH-DETERMINISM: Graph extracted from bas/fixtures/medium-realistic/ is byte-identical across three independent runs
Cross-scenario Connect-RPC calls into go-code-graph and typescript-code-graph fixture servers succeed and return valid graphs
Cartographer never invokes any direct file-read or AST-parse code path during graph extraction
Graph extraction for scenarios with ≤200 files completes in <5 seconds end-to-end
Graph extraction for scenarios with ≤2000 files completes in <30 seconds end-to-end
A scenario owner can run arch-cart extract and receive a fully populated graph without manually invoking go-code-graph or typescript-code-graph
Graph output is stable enough to be checked into version control as a baseline artifact

title: Ground-Truth Code Graph
